note: Curated standard catalogue of wear/service/replacement parts. `applies` narrows an entry to the vehicles it exists on: kind (motorcycle|car), types/notTypes (web/counter/js/vehicle-type.js TYPES), drive (chain|belt|shaft), cooling (liquid|air), fuel (efi|carb|petrol|diesel). A key that is absent means the entry applies to every vehicle of that kind. `searchHint` is appended to make/model/year to build the fitment-exact shop query; `synonyms` are what a manual calls it, used by the mentions pass in api/app/parts_catalog.py.
